title: Gulf View Home w/ Pool Panama City Beach FL
meta_description: Three cheers to Nightcap Cottage, a beach home located on beautiful scenic 30A just steps from the beach and a leisurely stroll to the town of Seaside. This two-story bungalow provides all the amenities needed for a not-to-be-forgotten vacation experience.
description_expanded: AboutNightcap Cottage – Old Seagrove Charm with Gulf Views on 30A Across the Street from the Beach | Gulf Views | Pet Friendly | Four Parking Spaces Welcome to Nightcap Cottage, a two-story beach bungalow that perfectly captures the relaxed spirit of Old Seagrove. Nestled beneath the shade of coastal trees and located right on Scenic Highway 30A, this inviting coastal retreat offers the best of both worlds—timeless Florida charm and modern comfort. Just steps to the beach access and a short stroll to Seaside’s shops and restaurants, Nightcap Cottage is the ideal home base for families and friends looking to unwind, explore, and experience the laid-back 30A lifestyle. Your four-legged family member is also welcome here. Why Guests Love Nightcap Cottage, a 30A vacation rental • Across the Street from the Beach- Enjoy easy beach access directly across 30A. Start your mornings with Gulf views and the sound of the waves. • Old Seagrove Location- Stay in the heart of Seagrove Beach, surrounded by historic charm and just minutes from Seaside’s dining, shopping, and entertainment. • Open-Concept Living- Gather in the comfortable living room with plush sectional seating, a Smart TV, and plenty of space for everyone to relax after a day in the sun. • Well-Equipped Kitchen and Dining- A rattan dining set and breakfast bar with stools make family meals easy and comfortable. The kitchen features stainless steel appliances and all the essentials you need for home-cooked dinners or quick beach snacks. • Outdoor Living Spaces- Lounge beneath the trees, grill out on the patio, or enjoy evening cocktails in the fresh Gulf breeze. After a day at the beach, rinse off in the private outdoor shower and store sandy gear in the outdoor storage area—stocked with four beach chairs and an umbrella. • Four Parking Spaces- A rare find on 30A—there is plenty of room for multiple vehicles or golf carts. • Smart TVs Throughout- Each bedroom and the living area feature Smart TVs and cable for easy entertainment. • Dedicated Workspace- Need to check in on work? Slip away to the enclosed first-floor porch with a desk for privacy and focus. • Pet Friendly- Bring your furry friend along—Nightcap Cottage welcomes pets so the entire family can enjoy the beach together. • Four backpack beach chairs and one beach umbrella • Starter amenity packs including Starbucks coffee and bottled waters Sleeping Arrangements (Sleeps 12) First Floor: • Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Ensuite Bathroom with Tub and Shower Combination • Living Room: Queen Sleeper Sofa • Private Enclosed Porch: Desk and Workspace Second Floor • Two Guest Bedrooms: Each with King Beds, Ensuite Jack and Jill Bathroom with Walk-In Shower • Sleeping Porch: Four Twin Beds – a fun and cozy space for children or additional guests Your Old Florida Escape Awaits With Gulf views, beach access just steps away, and the character of an Old Seagrove home, Nightcap Cottage invites you to slow down, relax, and savor the beauty of 30A. From family vacations to multi-generational gatherings, this classic coastal retreat offers everything you need for a comfortable and memorable beach getaway. Raise your glass and toast to your next unforgettable stay at Nightcap Cottage—your Old Seagrove sanctuary by the sea.
